name: narration
quote: I think that's what's going on.
description: The mind's process of continuously adjusting a mental model from sensations and desires about what's happening into an internal story acceptable to yourself and important social groups.
perceptions: Sensations and desires happen in a continuous stream.
I want to know what's happening in the world so I can make appropriate decisions.
I'm socially expected to know what's going on inside, so I'd better have an answer ready.
results: a mental model of what's happening inside and out

variations.name: inner dialogue
variations.description: Being consciously aware of yourself internally reflecting on a situation or just daydreaming. This is a more tangible form of narrative sense-making, though research suggests that fewer than half of us have regular language-based inner conversations.
perceptions: I'm internally reflecting on a decision, on my situation, etc.

guidance.description: 8 Tips to Gain Control Over Negative Self-Talk
Do You Have an Internal Dialogue? Not Everyone Does

comparisons.description: 'Narration' is the term used here for the continuous update of the internal models we use to interact with the world. For most of us, this process is unconscious and subconscious, but some people have partial interactive access to it with an 'inner dialogue'. This dialogue can be language-based or more visual imagery.

commentaries.quote: The inner voice is a fundamental aspect of human cognition and consciousness. It plays a significant role in shaping our perceptions, attitudes and behavior. It can influence how we interpret events, make choices and respond to various situations.

Evolution has shaped us with perceptions that allow us to survive. But part of that involves hiding from us the stuff we don’t need to know. And that’s pretty much all of reality, whatever that might be.

Honestly trying to summarize what's happening across your 86 billion neurons is a difficult task because much of what's happening is unconscious. There are subtle signs available, but we often find it advantageous to ignore them.

Underlying the internal narration is a sense that the story is critical both in content and vibe. We have to know what's going on to be in control. We have to know what's going on to be able to answer to our social groups and to our gods. Sometimes the narration is honest, while other times it's slanted to make yourself look better or worse than you really are. Since this process happens automatically, it may be useful to try and watch how it's happening.
